question: For NOAA SWPC ACE SWEPAM hourly real-time bulk parameters, is hourly S computed from the last minute, any bad minute, or another documented exact rule?

confirmed.claim: NOAA SWPC separates 1-minute/5-minute averaged real-time products (ACE/daily) and 1-hour averaged real-time products (ACE2/monthly), separately linking ACE science products.

The July 30, 1998 announcement says SEC creates monthly hourly averages, recreates the current month every three hours beginning 0010 UT, and creates the prior month for the last time on the first day of the next month. This is a dated file-generation schedule, not interval/quality specification.
NOAA says instrument teams supplied real-time processing algorithms; SWEPAM processing changed at 0000 UTC June 1, 2006. No executable, repository SHA or 2025 build is identified on this page.
ACE RTSW telemetry format is explicitly Version 2/2/96 and includes SWEPAM ion data created specifically for RTSW; it is a transport layout rather than hourly quality-reduction implementation.
